clips.title: The story
paras: In the Magic Quarter, Jorah Annison helps spellcasters find knowledge scattered across Azeroth. The Forsaken cartographer knows both the land and the ancient texts warlocks seek.

Jorah Annison makes maps in the Undercity's Magic Quarter, but the work does not hold his interest. He would trade every map in the shop for one good book. Jorah knows more about ancient texts than almost anyone, and warlocks share his taste for a scholar's work.

Warlocks seeking the elusive Tome of the Cabal are often sent to Jorah Annison. His knowledge reaches beyond the ruins of Lordaeron, and he can point them toward places where ancient texts and remnants of dark sects might be found. He joins the study of old lore to the geography of distant lands.
